Dequeued from the merge queue: signature and first diagnosis (2026-10-11T08:17Z). `domain:devx` @ objectui seat 1, `session_01DwLS3LzXyNmyTunMGbpc8W`.

**Signature (new; no card or ledger entry carries it)**
- Run: `CI` merge-group run `38123042596`, job `Test (shard 7/8)` (`114421544525`), failing step 8 `Run tests (shard 7/8)`. Queue commit `d3fd29728e` = this PR's head `b21a21ee` on top of `main` `802f0bc4`.
- First error: `AssertionError: expected [ +0, +0, +0, +0 ] to deeply equal []` at `packages/types/src/__tests__/element-data-source-objectname-waiver-11117.test.ts:121:27`. The test: 「object-kanban: a node with NEITHER is still refused, keyed RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED」. The issue was raised, but its `path` was `[0,0,0,0]`, not the expected `[]`.

**First diagnosis (a hypothesis, to be confirmed by reproduction)**: test-order pollution, introduced by this PR.
- The `unit` vitest project runs with `isolate: false` (`vitest.config.mts:382`), so files in one worker share module state.
- This PR's new `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-json-fences.test.ts` uses top-level `await import()` to load the BUILT `@object-ui/types` zod face and the built CLI door. In shard 7 it ran at 2026-10-11T08:06:14Z. The failing source-face test ran at 2026-10-11T08:06:22Z, in the same shard.
- On the PR head's own CI the two files were not co-located, which is why that run was green.
- ⛔ Not `main`: no commit between this PR's base `29b99490` and `802f0bc4` changes a `packages/types` schema (`69bca0af` touches only a comment block in `data.ts`). The failing file was last changed on `main` in `55e90fd3`.

**Action:** ⛔ not re-queued, because a new signature is a new problem. A patch round goes to the original dev: reproduce the order, find the root cause, fix it inside this PR. ⛔ No skip, quarantine or re-ordering hack.

It was still inside step 8 `Run tests (shard 2/8)` when it was cancelled at 1500 s, and its log was not retained (the log endpoint answers `BlobNotFound`). The aggregate `Test` check failed on that alone.
- **Why it is not this diff's:**
  - The patch round's two changed test files ran in shard 7, which passed in 1012 s. `vitest` printed result lines there for `check-doc-json-fences.test.ts` and `element-data-source-objectname-waiver-11117.test.ts`. Shard 2 printed neither.
  - The round's only source change is a one-line array copy in `requireRecordSource`.
  - The other seven shards passed in 556–1053 s. On the previous head `b21a21ee`, shard 2 passed in 940 s.
  - A cancelled job with no retained log and no failed assertion fits a hung worker or a lost runner. That is a reading, not a root cause.
- **Re-run:** this seat has no means to re-run a job. The write relay has no re-run op, and the seat does not write with a personal account. **One re-run of `Test (shard 2/8)` by someone with Actions write access settles it.** A second failure would be real, and it would go back to the dev as a patch round.
- **State:** not enqueued. Auto-merge is off and stays off until every check on the landing head is green and the contract-review record for this head is posted.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cd5e0d0c25d52bb2127db80e71cce2c594443ac5`

Inputs: card objectui#5250 (body and all 35 comments), PR objectui#12127 (body, 25-file list, net diff against `main` at `802f0bc4`), and the 42 check-runs on the head. Reads of `origin/main` were `git grep` / REST `contents` only; nothing was built, run or re-run. Shape: head repo equals base repo; +1272 / -220 (under 3000); no governed path (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success); `Clause-②: no` at a line start; first body line `Part of #5250`, no closing keyword.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/types` (published), `requireRecordSource` in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`: the refinement now hands `addIssue` a fresh copy (`path: [...path]`) instead of the array built once when the arm was defined. Accept set unchanged for all nine arms that share the refinement (`object-map`, `object-gantt`, `object-calendar`, `object-kanban`, `object-grid`, `list-view`, `object-tree`, `object-pivot`, `embeddable-form`); code, message and `params.code` unchanged; no export added, removed or renamed. The defect is real and published: zod copies an added issue shallowly and prefixes `path` in place, so one nested refusal rewrote every later bare refusal of the arm for the life of the module, which `objectui check` and repeated `objectui validate` calls read. RIGHT, as a patch-level diagnostic fix. Re-derived on `origin/main` that this is the only `addIssue` in `packages/types/src` whose `path` argument is a kept identifier (25 sites; the one `addIssue` text outside the package, in app-shell `MetadataService.ts`, is a doc comment with an inline literal), so the dev's one-instance claim holds.
- The regression pin appended to `element-data-source-objectname-waiver-11117.test.ts` (describe `a refusal reported from inside a container leaves the next one where it was`) reuses that file's existing `ARMS`, `REFUSAL_PATH`, `recordSourceIssues`, `explain` and `Parsed` (all present at base), refuses each arm nested under `card.children` then bare, and asserts the bare path did not move. It is red on the defect by construction and asserts no new accept-set fact. RIGHT.
- Root-package tooling (root `package.json` is `private: true`, so nothing here publishes): new gate `scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` (`pnpm check:doc-json`); four more exports from `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` (`MIN_REASON_LENGTH`, `quoteDepthOf`, `stripQuotePrefix`, `isBlankAtDepth`) so both gates read quoted fences and fragment reasons by one rule; eight `DOC_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS` deleted in `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`, each tied to a snippet this diff removes (shrink-only, and `Doc Component Type Check` is green, so none went stale); one `ADJUDICATED` entry in `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` matching what the new test reads (`content/docs/**`) and writes (a fixture `README.md`). RIGHT.
- The gate itself answers the ruling (`5534418546`): judged on `StrictAnyComponentSchema` read from the BUILT `./zod` entry (RESOLUTION control refuses a face outside `packages/types/dist/`), the face `validateAuthoredDocument` runs; the tolerant face is read for words only; REFUSES / ACCEPTS / ANTI-IDLE controls run before any verdict; exit 0 / 1 / 2 as the sibling gates. Fragments follow the objectui#5138 design: an explicit `doc-json: fragment` marker with a written reason, re-judged every run (stale on an accepted fence or a non-document, dangling, too short, or a verification claim is a finding). The population reads MORE than the measurement priced (`jsonc` via `jsonc-parser` with `objectui check`'s options; blockquoted fences), never less. The rendering face's `.passthrough()` is untouched (`base.zod.ts` is not in the diff). RIGHT.
- The agreement test (`scripts/__tests__/check-doc-json-fences.test.ts`, `one authority` describe) runs the CLI door `validateAuthoredDocument` and the gate's judge over the whole corpus PLUS the two controls, and asserts both verdicts occur. The controls were added this round because an ablation showed the corpus alone could not tell a tolerant door (every corpus refusal is red on both faces); with them the same ablation goes red. RIGHT, and it is what the "one authority" claim rests on.
- `.github/workflows/doc-snippet-types.yml`: one step appended after the `--build-filter` build and after both sibling gates; no new build step. The job's steps on this head show step 11 `Judge JSON doc fences through the strict authoring face` ran and concluded success, which also proves the closure carries a built `@object-ui/types` (the gate would exit 2 otherwise). The check-run name `Doc Snippet Type Check` is unchanged, so its binding in the required set is unchanged. `.github/workflows/**` is not a governed surface here. RIGHT.
- `content/docs/**`, 14 pages (the prose face): 29 refusals on the dispatch base are each repaired or declared; after the diff 185 node documents are judged, 179 accepted, 6 declared fragments each confirmed refused, 0 refused, and the gate's green on this head is the proof. Spot-checked beyond the seat's review: `expressions.md` now teaches `{ "type": "list", "bind": "users" }` and says a `list` draws one row per entry, a string or an object whose `content` is a node; `list.tsx` reads `schema.bind` then `schema.items` and renders `typeof item === 'string' ? item : renderChildren(item.content)`, and `ListItemSchema.content` is a union of a node and a node array, so the sentence matches both renderer and schema. The six declarations each state why the fence is deliberately not a complete node (refused example, reader-registered type, type-only skeleton, a `globalFilters[]` member whose `type` collides with the `select` node). The `ci-cd-pipeline.md` row and new section describe the wiring as the workflow diff has it (three gates, one job; the json gate last). RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no` is RIGHT: no contract face's accept set widens or narrows. The strict face, the tolerant face and every node schema are unchanged except the refinement's issue-path copy, which changes what is reported, not what is accepted.
- `.changeset/5250-record-source-issue-path.md`, `'@object-ui/types': patch`, is RIGHT: a bug fix in a released package takes a patch, never none; the body names the mechanism, the symptom (`objectui check` over a project, repeated `objectui validate`) and that code, message and refusal are unchanged; no `major` (objectui's fixed-group rule); no model identifier. `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Claim Re-read` and `Changeset Overwrite Report` are all success on the head. Nothing else in the diff publishes (root package private; docs and workflows are not package contract).
- FLAG, not a semver fault: the PR body still describes head `3c0d3123` and says "nothing under `packages/` changes" and "no changeset is owed, so none is added". Both were true at `3c0d3123` and are false at `cd5e0d0c`. The `Clause-②: no` line itself stays right. This record is the correction of record for this head; the adopting seat posts the cd5e0d0c addendum the dev drafted (merge of `main` `802f0bc4`; fix(types) per-issue path in `requireRecordSource` for the merge-queue shard 7 failure, plus pin, plus `@object-ui/types` patch changeset; the agreement test also runs the controls through the CLI door) as a PR comment, the form the slice A review of record used for the same situation.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev reports on this branch: `6106791022` (head `b21a21ee`) and `6107208030` (head `cd5e0d0c`). Both carry `open_questions: []`. Every deviation and out-of-scope finding, answered:

1. File surface breach into `packages/types/**` (slice B's claim `6106262820` excluded it). Answered: authorized by the seat's dequeue directive `6107054670` ("find the root cause, fix it inside this PR; no skip, quarantine or re-ordering hack"). The root cause is in the published face, so a test-side workaround would have shipped the defect; the patch changeset is what makes the breach visible to consumers. Accepted.
2. Pin added to the existing 11117 file rather than a new file. Answered: it reuses that file's arm table and helpers, which is the right home. Accepted.
3. Agreement test strengthened with the controls (a scope addition beyond "show it red as before"). Answered: required, because the ablation showed the prior test could not detect a tolerant door, and a check that cannot fail is not a check. Accepted.
4. PM hypothesis partly falsified (the leak crossed files through the SOURCE face reached by vitest aliases, not a dist import). Answered: informational; the fix is at the source either way and the pin runs on the source face. Accepted.
5. PR body stale at `cd5e0d0c`. Answered in ② above: addendum comment owed by the adopting seat.
6. Commit trailers model-free and worktrees removed. Answered: as the rules require; no action.
7. Out-of-scope finding, zod's shallow issue copy plus in-place path prefixing as a class, "noted, not filed (no second instance measured)". Answered: re-derived on `origin/main`, the fixed site is the only kept-array `path` among the 25 `addIssue` calls in `packages/types/src`; with no second instance a card has no evidence to name, so the disposition stands. The regression pin and the changeset text carry the mechanism for the next author; a mechanical guard is the seat's call, not a condition of this verdict.
8. From `6106791022` (unchanged on this head): the three surface extensions (`ci-cd-pipeline.md`, `check-doc-component-types.mjs`, `markdown-test-inputs.mjs`) were each forced by an existing pin or a sentence this change made false and were added to the claim by review `6106846211`; the wider population (jsonc, blockquotes) reads more and every newly read refusal is repaired or declared; the rewrites in `vscode-extension.mdx`, `expressions.md` and the removed `marketing.mdx` analytics subsection replace teaching of capabilities that do not exist (the `objectui-*` prefixes, an unknown-property error, a list item template, an `analytics` executor), which is the rule against advertising what the runtime does not deliver. Accepted. Its out-of-scope findings are disposed: form-field `defaultChecked` / `defaultValue` read at runtime but refused by the strict face is filed as objectui#12130; the four refused README json documents outside `content/docs` and the three interface blocks teaching refused keys are filed as objectui#12131, with the gate's header stating the `content/docs` bound; `dashboard.ts` runtime slots, the measurement script's jsonc/blockquote blindness (carrier: the objectui#8346 reopen condition) and the 12 catalog fixtures red on both faces are acceptance notes that predate this card. Right dispositions.
